issue.title: [smartswitch][upgrade_image] upgrade_by_sonic fails after reboot when DPU SSH proxy ports are not yet up

failure.body:
## Description

`upgrade_image.py` fails with `HostsUnreachable` after successfully rebooting the switch,
because it immediately calls `config_facts` on DPU hosts before their SSH proxy ports
(e.g. ports 5021–5024 on the switch management IP) have come up post-reboot.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `upgrade_image.py` on a SmartSwitch DUT that has DPUs configured
2. Image is installed successfully and switch reboots
3. Switch management IP becomes reachable
4. `upgrade_by_sonic` immediately calls `config_facts` on all hosts including DPUs
5. DPU SSH proxy ports are still `Connection refused` → `HostsUnreachable` exception → crash

## Error

```
devutil.devices.ansible_hosts.HostsUnreachable: upgrade_by_sonic#66: config_facts failed with hosts unreachable:
dpu-0: ssh: connect to host <mgmt-ip> port 5021: Connection refused
dpu-1: ssh: connect to host <mgmt-ip> port 5022: Connection refused
dpu-2: ssh: connect to host <mgmt-ip> port 5023: Connection refused
dpu-3: ssh: connect to host <mgmt-ip> port 5024: Connection refused
```

## Root Cause

In `ansible/devutil/devices/sonic.py::upgrade_by_sonic`, after triggering a reboot
and detecting the switch is back up, the script calls `config_facts` on all hosts
(including DPUs) without waiting for DPU SSH proxy ports to be available.

The initial reachability check (`check_reachability`) correctly skips DPU SSH checks:
```python
INFO - Skipping SSH check for DPU host: dpu-0
```

But `upgrade_by_sonic#66` then immediately calls `config_facts` on all DPU hosts, which fails because the SSH proxy service on the switch hasn't finished starting.

## Expected Behavior

After a switch reboot during image upgrade, the script should either:

- Skip `config_facts` on DPU hosts (since the switch image is what's being upgraded), or
- Add a wait/retry loop for DPU SSH proxy ports before calling `config_facts`

## Affected Files

- `.azure-pipelines/upgrade_image.py`
- `ansible/devutil/devices/sonic.py` (`upgrade_by_sonic` function, around line 66)

## Platform

SmartSwitch with DPUs (Mellanox/Nvidia BF3)

resolution.title: [smartswitch][upgrade_image] Enable NAT for DPU hosts after switch upgrade reboot
resolution.description:
## Description

After a switch reboot during image upgrade, NAT/DNAT rules on the NPU that
forward SSH traffic to DPU hosts are lost. This causes `HostsUnreachable` errors
when subsequent operations try to reach DPU hosts.

Fixes #22878

## Changes

### `ansible/devutil/devices/sonic.py`
- Added `is_nat_enabled_for_dpu()` — checks if DNAT rules for DPU SSH access exist
- Added `get_dpu_name_ssh_port_dict()` — builds DPU name to SSH port mapping from inventory
- Added `enable_nat_for_dpuhosts()` — enables IP forwarding and sets up DNAT rules via `sonic-dpu-mgmt-traffic.sh`

### `.azure-pipelines/upgrade_image.py`
- Separates NPU and DPU hostnames from the testbed
- Uses NPU-only `sonichosts` for upgrade/reboot operations
- Re-enables NAT after each upgrade reboot cycle (prev-image and target-image)

### `.azure-pipelines/testbed_health_check.py`
- Removed duplicate NAT helper functions (~115 lines)
- Now imports and delegates to the canonical implementation in `sonic.py`

## How it was tested

- Reviewed against existing NAT enablement patterns in `testbed_health_check.py` and
`tests/conftest.py`. The implementation mirrors the same `sonic-dpu-mgmt-traffic.sh`
invocation pattern used by the test framework.

- Verified `testbed_health_check.py` and `upgrade_image.py` for both smart-switch and non-smart-switch
